# sakura_networking_suite_subnet_group (Data Source)

Get information of a Networking Suite Subnet Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sakura_networking_suite_subnet_group" "foobar" {
  name = "foobar"
  # or srn
  # srn = "subnet-group-srn" # e.g. srnv1:sakura-is1:sakura.networking-suite.subnet-group:1234567890
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the Networking Suite Subnet Group.
- `srn` (String) The SRN of the Networking Suite Subnet Group.
- `zone` (String) The target zone code of the subnet group

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the Networking Suite Subnet Group.
- `ipv4_address_range_cidr` (String) The IPv4 address range in CIDR format
- `region` (String) The target region code of the subnet group
